about_the_game:
This is Artifact Pack 1. It doubles the number of Artifacts in The Ditty of Carmeana.

You know how you smash pots open and get junk items that are not useful in any way in the game, except to sell to a pawnbroker for some pocket money?

Well, with this DLC, you will get some different items in the pots. That's it. I take your money, and literally all you get is some new items in the pots.

The frequency of the new items has even predetermined to result in the exact same proportion of valuable items.

This is so useless I should just call it Scam Pack 1. But it doesn't matter, you sheep will buy anything.

NOTE FROM DEVELOPER

This DLC has 35 new artifact items.  It was something I did on whimsy.  I thought, optimistically, it'd be kind of fun to do.  As for the price, well it's not the price I would have chosen, but the minimum is set by Steam.

If you're thinking there might be some hidden secrets in the DLC, nope.
